payload.sample:
.TH "NPM-VIEW" "1" "March 2026" "NPM@10.9.7" ""
.SH "NAME"
\fBnpm-view\fR - View registry info
.SS "Synopsis"
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm view \[lB]<package-spec>\[rB] \[lB]<field>\[lB].subfield\[rB]...\[rB]

aliases: info, show, v
.fi
.RE
.SS "Description"
.P
This command shows data about a package and prints it to stdout.
.P
As an example, to view information about the \fBconnect\fR package from the registry, you would run:
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm view connect
.fi
.RE
.P
The default version is \fB"latest"\fR if
